bullets: Added background summarization of conversations so the assistant has a fresh recap ready after a five-minute pause or when context limits are reached.
Widened the free Desktop tab cap to five concurrent ordinary-model workspaces for tier 1 and 2 accounts instead of the default three.
Moved MiMo v2.6 Flash Slow, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Slow, and MiMo v2.6 Flash Fast models to the More section in the free model picker.
Set DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as the default model for all speed presets and moved GPT-6 Luna to the More section in the full-access picker.
Changed the fast-mode DeepSeek agent to run a standard single-loop instead of splitting tasks across multiple helper agents.
Updated Freebucks refund messages to state that refunds apply only to full-access sessions ended within 30 minutes.
Updated Freebucks refund calculation text to explain that the amount returned is based on half the session's price minus usage.
Hid the daily time-remaining counter in the CLI for full-access users who have used less than 75% of their daily allowance.
Added a warning at CLI startup that detects and reports when external code was loaded before the application started running.
Enabled transferring chat state between different devices by recognizing the same project across computers with a simplified repository address.
Fixed the CLI to catch image compression failures and display a specific error advising users to convert files to PNG or JPEG.
Improved the display of streamed text in the CLI by committing stable prefixes and parsing only newly added slices for smoother rendering.
